Evan Park: NewFrontier wants a 3-week POC for clinical triage using their custom model nft-16b-med-v3. They need model-hosting options (Private in their VPC preferred), per-customer KMS/BYOK, and a cost estimate for up to 1.5M input tokens/week. Also asked about variant suggestions + fallback for latency spikes.
Priya Shah: Do we have HF or S3 artifact? Any idea about tokenizer / rope/positional style?
Evan Park: HF link provided in NDA channel: hf://newfrontier/nft-16b-med-v3. They say avg input ~900 tokens, outputs ~120, but some sessions chain to 6k via notes stitching.
Marco Li: Ops notes: 6k contexts => we should enable KV caching + chunking. For 16b family recommend q4_k_m quantization; try a 16b-int8-kv variant for perf. Fallback: nft-8b-lite for latency-sensitive routes.
Ava Thompson: Security: they'll need SOC2 + DPA, and explicit non-training clause for PHI. Also wants ability to disable request logging and purge data after POC. I'll need the filled questionnaire to kick legal off.
Evan Park: I'll upload questionnaire and sample prompts. Can we get a quick ballpark for Dedicated sizing and a pricing credit for a 3-week trial?
Marco Li: Rough infra plan: 2x A100-80GB Dedicated with kv-shards and prefix caching should handle most traces. If they insist on Private we need a 10-day install window. For fast turnaround propose hosted Dedicated + VPC peering first.
Priya Shah: SE runbook snippet for tokenizer and perf checks: 
```
redwoodctl model inspect --model hf://newfrontier/nft-16b-med-v3
redwoodctl perf run --model nft-16b-med-v3 --quant q4_k_m --kv interleaved --seq-len 6144 --batch 1
```
Priya Shah: Also run tokenizer diff to check special tokens: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').decode([0,1,2]))"`
ops-bot: Ticket created POC-8342: "NewFrontier nft-16b-med-v3 POC - HIPAA/DPA, PKI/KMS". Assigned: eng-runtime, sales-eng, legal. Link: <internal/POC-8342>.
Marco Li: I'll queue perf jobs (q4_k_m + fp16) and validate RMSNorm/LayerNorm kernels; report perf by EOD Tue.
Ava Thompson: I'll prep legal intake and confirm BYOK/HSM flows. Need confirmation we can disable logs and provide data deletion report after trial.
Evan Park: Great. Can Sales Eng provide perf summary and a 3-option pricing sketch (usage-only, short Dedicated commit, Private install quote) before the kickoff call Fri 11am PT?
Priya Shah: On it. Will post perf traces and a short quality/regression check vs their hallucination probes.
Evan Park: Thanks all :thumbsup:
